content.json:
## 🖥️ Azure Local - Managing Updates At Scale
**Version: v0.3.1** | [View on GitHub](https://github.com/NeilBird/PowerShell-Snippnets/tree/main/Azure-Local-Manage-Updates-At-Scale)

For issues or feedback, please [raise an issue on GitHub](https://github.com/NeilBird/PowerShell-Snippnets/issues).

### Filter Instructions
- **Subscriptions**: Select one or more subscriptions to filter data (defaults to all accessible subscriptions)
- **Resource Group Filter**: Optional wildcard filter for resource group names. Use `*` as wildcard (e.g., `*-prod-*` matches 'rg-hci-prod-01')
- **Cluster Tag**: Optional tag filter applies only to Azure Local clusters (not AKS Arc or VMs). Enter both Tag Name and Tag Value to filter.

---

### ⚠️ Quick Actions
[Create Azure Monitor Alert Rule](https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_Monitoring/AzureMonitoringBrowseBlade/~/alertsV2) | [View Activity Log](https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_Monitoring/AzureMonitoringBrowseBlade/~/activityLog) | [Azure Advisor Recommendations](https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_Expert/AdvisorMenuBlade/~/overview) | [Azure Local Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-local/whats-new)

---

| where '{ResourceGroupFilter}' == '' or resourceGroup matches regex strcat('(?i)', replace_string(replace_string('{ResourceGroupFilter}', '*', '.*'), '?', '.'))
| extend status = tostring(properties.status)
| project arcbridgename = name, resourceGroup, status
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.azurestackhci/clusters"
    | where '{ResourceGroupFilter}' == '' or resourceGroup matches regex strcat('(?i)', replace_string(replace_string('{ResourceGroupFilter}', '*', '.*'), '?', '.'))
        | extend hcistatus = tostring(properties.status)
    | project hciname = name, resourceGroup, hcistatus
) on resourceGroup
| where hcistatus =~ "ConnectedRecently"

    TotalResources = count(),
    ArcBridgeCount = dcount(arcbridgename),
    HCIClusterCount = dcount(hciname)
    by ArcBridgeStatus = status, HCIClusterConnectivity = hcistatus
| order by ArcBridgeStatus asc

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines"
| where '{ResourceGroupFilter}' == '' or resourceGroup matches regex strcat('(?i)', replace_string(replace_string('{ResourceGroupFilter}', '*', '.*'), '?', '.'))
| where properties.cloudMetadata.provider == "AzSHCI"
| project machineId = id, machineName = name, machineResourceGroup = resourceGroup
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.azurestackhci/clusters"
    | where '{ResourceGroupFilter}' == '' or resourceGroup matches regex strcat('(?i)', replace_string(replace_string('{ResourceGroupFilter}', '*', '.*'), '?', '.'))
    | where '{ClusterTagName}' == '' or ('{ClusterTagValue}' != '' and tostring(tags['{ClusterTagName}']) =~ '{ClusterTagValue}')
    | project clusterResourceGroup = resourceGroup
) on $left.machineResourceGroup == $right.clusterResourceGroup
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions"
    | where '{ResourceGroupFilter}' == '' or resourceGroup matches regex strcat('(?i)', replace_string(replace_string('{ResourceGroupFilter}', '*', '.*'), '?', '.'))
    | extend status = tostring(properties.provisioningState)
    | extend extensionName = tostring(name)
    | parse id with * "/machines/" mName "/extensions/" *
    | project extensionName, status, mName, resourceGroup
) on $left.machineName == $right.mName and $left.machineResourceGroup == $right.resourceGroup
| where '*' in ({ExtensionNameFilter}) or extensionName in ({ExtensionNameFilter})
| where '*' in ({ExtensionStatusFilter}) or status in ({ExtensionStatusFilter})
| summarize count() by extensionName, status
| summarize 
    Succeeded = sumif(count_, status == "Succeeded"),
    Failed = sumif(count_, status == "Failed"),
    Creating = sumif(count_, status == "Creating"),
    Updating = sumif(count_, status == "Updating"),
    Deleting = sumif(count_, status == "Deleting"),
    Other = sumif(count_, status !in ("Succeeded", "Failed", "Creating", "Updating", "Deleting"))
    by extensionName
| project extensionName, Succeeded, Failed, Creating, Updating, Deleting, Other
| order by extensionName asc

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurestackhci/clusters"
| where '{ResourceGroupFilter}' == '' or resourceGroup matches regex strcat('(?i)', replace_string(replace_string('{ResourceGroupFilter}', '*', '.*'), '?', '.'))
| where '{ClusterTagName}' == '' or ('{ClusterTagValue}' != '' and tostring(tags['{ClusterTagName}']) =~ '{ClusterTagValue}')
| project clusterName = name, clusterId = id, resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| join kind=inner (
    extensibilityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.azurestackhci/clusters/updatesummaries"
    | where '{ResourceGroupFilter}' == '' or resourceGroup matches regex strcat('(?i)', replace_string(replace_string('{ResourceGroupFilter}', '*', '.*'), '?', '.'))
    | extend hciClusterName = tostring(split(id, '/')[8])
    | extend healthState = tostring(properties.healthState)
    | extend state = tostring(properties.state)
    | extend lastChecked = todatetime(properties.lastChecked)
    | extend currentVersion = tostring(properties.currentVersion)
    | project hciClusterName, healthState, state, lastChecked, currentVersion
) on $left.clusterName == $right.hciClusterName
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines"
    | where '{ResourceGroupFilter}' == '' or resourceGroup matches regex strcat('(?i)', replace_string(replace_string('{ResourceGroupFilter}', '*', '.*'), '?', '.'))
    | where properties.cloudMetadata.provider == "AzSHCI"
    | summarize nodeCount = count() by resourceGroup
) on resourceGroup
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines"
    | where '{ResourceGroupFilter}' == '' or resourceGroup matches regex strcat('(?i)', replace_string(replace_string('{ResourceGroupFilter}', '*', '.*'), '?', '.'))
    | where kind == "HCI"
    | summarize VMCount = count() by resourceGroup
) on resourceGroup
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.kubernetes/connectedclusters"
    | where '{ResourceGroupFilter}' == '' or resourceGroup matches regex strcat('(?i)', replace_string(replace_string('{ResourceGroupFilter}', '*', '.*'), '?', '.'))
    | where properties.infrastructure == "azure_stack_hci"
    | summarize AKSArcCount = count() by resourceGroup
) on resourceGroup
| where clusterName in ({clustername})
| where healthState in ({healthState})
| extend DaysSinceLastCheck = datetime_diff('day', now(), lastChecked)
| extend clusterLink = strcat('https://portal.azure.com/#@/resource', clusterId)
| project clusterName, clusterLink, healthState, state, currentVersion, lastChecked, DaysSinceLastCheck, resourceGroup, nodeCount = coalesce(nodeCount, 0), VMCount = coalesce(VMCount, 0), AKSArcCount = coalesce(AKSArcCount, 0)
| order by DaysSinceLastCheck desc, clusterName asc

| where severity in ({severity})
